list.title: Co-pilots
list.description: Each co-pilot has its own script, objection library, knowledge and style. Create one per product, audience or call stage.

empty.descriptionManage: Pick a template like Generic Cold Call or B2B Discovery and tailor it to your product in a couple of minutes.
empty.descriptionMember: An admin of this organisation creates the co-pilots you'll use on calls.

card.deleteDescription: The co-pilot is permanently deleted. Past calls keep their transcripts and analyses.

editor.newDescription: Start from a template or from scratch. You can change everything later.
editor.editDescription: Script, knowledge, objection handling, style and scoring for this co-pilot.

analysis.title: Scoring categories
analysis.description: What the post-call analysis scores and how much each category counts toward the overall score.

basics.title: Basics
basics.description: What this co-pilot is for and the outcome it pushes toward.
basics.name: Name
basics.purposePlaceholder: Short cold calls to dental clinic owners, focused on booking a demo.
basics.callGoalHint: The co-pilot keeps steering the conversation toward this outcome.
basics.defaultHint: Pre-selected when you start a call.

knowledge.tooLargeHint: Files up to 2 MB are supported.
knowledge.trimmedHint: Only the first {{max}} characters are kept.
knowledge.title: Knowledge & context
knowledge.description: Product details, pricing, FAQs, competitor comparisons, case studies, ideal customer profile. Used for answers and key info cards during calls.
knowledge.placeholder:
Product: …
Pricing: Starter $99/month per location, 50 seats $399/month
Key benefit: reduces no-shows by 30%
Competitors: …
FAQ: …

models.notConfigured: AI is not configured on the server yet, so suggestions and analysis are unavailable.
models.realtimeDescription: Speed matters most here: a late suggestion is a useless one.
models.analysisDescription: Analysis can favour depth over speed. If a model is unavailable, CallZen falls back to the recommended one and tells you.

objections.title: Objection library
objections.description: Common objections and the responses you prefer. When the prospect raises one, the co-pilot recognises it and suggests your answer, adapted to the moment.
objections.emptyDescription: Add the ones you hear most: "too expensive", "send me an email", "we already have a provider"…

script.title: Script
script.description: Organise your script in stages. The co-pilot follows it, tracks progress live, and adapts when the conversation goes elsewhere.
script.emptyDescription: Without a script the co-pilot relies on your goal, instructions and knowledge.
script.contentPlaceholder: What to say or ask in this stage. Use {placeholders} for names.

style.instructionsDescription: Rules the co-pilot always follows, in your own words.
style.instructionsPlaceholder:
Keep suggestions under 20 words.
Never discount more than 10%.
Always push for a specific meeting time.
style.suggestionsDescription: How often and how much the co-pilot shows during calls. You can also change frequency mid-call.
style.consentDescription: Recording laws differ by region and some require everyone's consent. You are responsible for getting it.
style.suggestConsentHint: The first suggestion of every call will be your disclosure line.
style.consentLineHint: Leave empty to use your default from Settings.

templates.scratchHint: Write your own script and rules

validation.name: Give your co-pilot a name
validation.stageContent: Write what to say in this stage
validation.categoryMin: Keep at least one scoring category
